description: This file defines the CalendarInterval class used in Apache Spark to represent calendar intervals with components for months, days, and microseconds. It includes methods for equality, hashing, string representation, extracting period and duration, and comparison.

classes.name: CalendarInterval
classes.description: A class representing calendar intervals with months, days, and microseconds components, supporting equality, string conversion, extraction of period/duration, and comparison.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this CalendarInterval is equal to another object based on months, days, and microseconds.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on months, days, and microseconds.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the interval, including years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

methods.name: extractAsPeriod
methods.description: Extracts the date part of the interval as a java.time.Period.

methods.name: extractAsDuration
methods.description: Extracts the time part of the interval as a java.time.Duration.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this CalendarInterval with another for equality based on months, days, and microseconds.
